note: Metadata-only inventory of Filmora effects for clean-room reimplementation. Preview/thumbnail paths point at the local Filmora installation (outside this repo); preview_url is the store's public preview. No Filmora asset is stored here.

sources.store_cache: ProgramData/resInfo.db table onlineCloudResourceInfo (store catalog rows cached while browsing)
sources.store_recent: ProgramData/resInfo.db table cloudResourceInfo (recently used / installed store rows)
sources.store_page: ProgramData/resInfo.db table resourcePageInfos (ordered category pages; gives page_rank)
sources.browsed_temp: ProgramData/Download/Temp/<type>/<res> (store items previewed but not installed)
sources.builtin: Filmora.app/Contents/Resources/resources/wfx_effect/material/{OpenGL,OpenCL,PureC}Filter.conf, wfx_effect/Transition, resources/captions/Animation.xml, Default Effects/Preset Animation, Default Effects/LightRoom
sources.usage: docs/filmora-coverage.md (items used in the reference projects)

fields.premium: store sale_mode == 1 (paid / subscription); null when unknown (slug-only entries)
fields.jb: Jibaru effect id when a filmora:<GUID> alias resolves in jb-render (implemented)
fields.jb_similar: registry item with the same name and kind (unverified look-alike, not counted as implemented)
fields.popularity.score: work-queue priority: user projects >> trending rank > highlights > page rank > downloaded/browsed
fields.measure: asset-free motion/brightness summary of the local preview video (see docs/filmora-catalog.md)
